title: The production Engram doctor timeout cannot be asserted by any test
outcome:
ENGRAM_ENABLEMENT_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT is 5 minutes under cfg(not(test)) and 30 seconds under cfg(test), so no test ever observes the production value. The comment beside it explicitly frames that number as measured evidence that expires and must be re-measured - yet nothing fails if someone silently lowers it back toward the old five seconds, which is exactly the defect it was raised to fix.

Fix direction: keep the production number in its own always-compiled constant and derive the cfg-gated test value from it, so a test can assert a production floor without waiting out the window. Raised by the Claude reviewer of the deadline change.
